blocks.body:
I opened the salon because I wanted a room where a haircut is a conversation, not a transaction. Fifteen years in, I still start every appointment at the basin and still ask the same question: what does your hair do on an ordinary Tuesday?

Colour is my thing. I mix to the hair in front of me rather than to a swatch, and I would rather send you home a shade lighter than you asked for than a shade you will regret. Bring a photograph, bring doubts — both are useful.

I work Tuesday to Saturday; Monday is for the garden.
blocks.title: Noa Keller
